title: Five Tips Five Separate Slides
tests: Tests one-to-one mapping of five supplied tips to five ordered slides without adding cover or closing slides.

faults.what: Oversized headings extend beyond the image edges on every slide, cutting off words or portions of letters; several tips cannot be read in full.
The required numbering is largely cropped away: only 2 is fully visible, 4 is partially visible, and 1, 3, and 5 are not readable.
The palette is cream, gray-brown, teal, and coral rather than the requested blue-and-white design.
The illustrations are large rather than small, and the output appears soft and pixelated.

judge.summary: Five portrait slides contain relevant illustrations, but severe heading and number cropping and the wrong color palette make the carousel unsuitable to post.

must_haves.item: Exactly five separate 4:5 portrait images are delivered, with no extra cover or closing slide.
must_haves.why: Five separate, approximately 4:5 portrait images are shown, without a cover or closing slide.

must_haves.item: The five supplied tips appear verbatim, one per slide, in the requested order.
must_haves.why: The visible text follows the intended order, but cropping prevents four of the five full phrases from appearing.

must_haves.item: The slides are visibly numbered 1 through 5 in sequence.
must_haves.why: Only slide 2 has a fully readable number; the other numbers are absent from view or clipped.

must_haves.item: Each slide has an illustration relevant to its specific tip.
must_haves.why: The slides respectively show a desk, a phone with a notification bell, a checked task, a timer, and a steaming cup with a plant.

must_haves.item: All slides share a clean blue-and-white visual design with readable, unclipped text.
must_haves.why: The slides share a layout, but use a cream, gray-brown, teal, and coral palette and have extensively clipped headings.
